self.title: When Should Independent Judgment Challenge Consensus?

detail.title: Independent Judgment versus Consensus Reliability
detail.summary: This revision synthesizes the limitations of consensus in high-uncertainty domains, drawing an analogy between A* search node expansion and epistemic diversity in consensus-seeking models.
detail.reason: Expanding the synthesis to bridge search complexity with epistemic consensus models.

detail.title: Independent Judgment versus Consensus Reliability
detail.question: Under what conditions should an intelligent system trust its own independent derivation over conflicting consensus conclusions from other agents?
detail.reason: Reactivating project to resolve the open commitment and refine the synthesized criteria.
